rows.en: Remove all mines and defeat the Virgo
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Today, you will continue with your mine-clearing duty.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: <mk(-50,50,1,0)><ar(0,1,0)>Your assigned area this time is <pic(0)><cs(3)>around the District 51 colony<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: With the war ending, there are plans to repair the colony and put it back into use.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Earth begins taking in the refugees today, but rebuilding space matters too.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: To build new homes in space, I want you to put your skills to good use again today.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The shuttle has been refilled with air. As they wished, we will leave the shuttle behind.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Ever since the decision to take in the refugees, they have been holding out in that spot.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: They have something they believe in. We are in no position to deny it now.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We have no time either. We are setting course for Earth at once.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We must stop it, whatever it takes. This plan, of all things...
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Does this mean we are still not strong enough to bring about peace...?
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?
